titles.title: [소프트 BL 단편선] 사춘기 : 너를 생각하는 봄

description:
The year is 2001. At Yujung High School, known as a gathering place for troublemakers, a bloody battle rages daily between students vying for the top spot and the Disciplinary Committee trying to stop them. Amidst this chaos, there is one sanctuary where peace can be found... the school’s very own paradise: the “infirmary.” Having toppled the previous leader, Jang Jin-Tae, the Tiger, became the school’s new boss. Just when it seemed he had finally taken over the infirmary and secured absolute power, a suspicious-looking, womanizing transfer student, Sin Jong-U, was already casually occupying the space.

 *“Who… are you?”*

Jin-Tae boldly ordered Jong-U to get out of the infirmary. But all he got in return was a sharp slap from Jong-U. Having fallen from the top spot to second place in just 13 minutes, Jin-Tae challenges Jong-U once again to reclaim the infirmary and his position as the top dog, but Jong-U seems to have some other ulterior motive...?

The Playboy Transfer Student X The Bulldozer School Leader A full-on school-based romantic comedy where bodies collide and hearts clash, The Battle for the Infirmary Bed!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*Note: The fifth story in the Sachungi: Neoreul Saenggakaneun Bom (사춘기: 너를 생각하는 봄) Collection.*
